title: Senki Zesshou Symphogear XV: Senki Zesshou Shinai Symphogear
justification: AniList 113348 has 4 episodes (2019-12-04, 2020-01-08, 2020-02-05, 2020-03-04; synonyms 'Symphogear XV Omake'). AniDB 11959 S1-S4 are the four monthly Shinai Symphogear omnibus shorts (S1 'Just Before the Birthday Party 1..' on 12-04, S2 'Just Before the Start of XV' 01-08, S3 'Right After the End of AXZ' 02-05, S4 'A Week Before Departing for Antarctica' 03-04). TVDB 254667 0x13-0x16 are 'Not-So-Superb Song of the Valkyries: Symphogear XV 1-4' on the same four dates. S5 (2019-10-02 premiere screening) is excluded.
